name: Mill third person plain baseline
expression: async()=>{Realm.test.setTime(16);document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="adventure"]').click();const walk=async(x,z)=>{const r=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);const start=performance.now();while(Realm.test.path.length){if(performance.now()-start>60000)throw Error('walk timeout');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}};await walk(0,23);document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'e',bubbles:true}));document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:'e',bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('[data-rpg=earth-confirm]').click();await walk(0,10);await walk(7,2);await walk(8.9,-7.9);Realm.test.view({yaw:.95,elevation:.32,distance:8});Realm.test.surfaceMaterials(false);Realm.test.render();return Realm.diagnostics.scene}
